sections.heading: Array
sections.markdown: The new-XIR source subset in spec §17.26 admits typed and homogeneous literals, contextual empty literals, ordinary logical copies, parameters/returns, index reads/writes, get/set/push and global len. Array is a value struct; COW preserves independent copies without explicit copy/move. Its source-derived inventory contains 32 members, but only get/set/push have admitted member operations; the other 29 remain inventory-only. Constructor calls, capacity, slices, pointers, iteration and higher-order methods require separate admission.

sections.heading: Exact structural object / dynamic JSON object
sections.markdown: Structural objects have compile-time-known fields and exact shapes. Dynamic JSON objects use `JSON.Object`, a pure alias for `Map<string, JSON.Value>`.

sections.heading: Index access
sections.markdown: For the new-XIR Array subset, get/index reads return independently owned elements and bounds are strict: 0 <= index < len. E0430 preserves the signed index and observed length. Index reads preserve the receiver selected before index evaluation; writes resolve the current root after argument/RHS evaluation. Set/push return unit, while index assignment returns the converted RHS. Len reads length without allocation or element traversal. See spec §17.26 for ownership and qualification limits.

sections.heading: Other collection-like types
bullets: `Array<u8>` is a typed byte buffer backed by contiguous memory
